Break up row 6 and the central clues to remove easy singles.

Empty the right-hand side clues so that rows 5 and 6 and the right boxes are no longer nearly complete.

Break up the nearly full row 2 and row 8 so that no line is close to complete.
Remove givens across several boxes so that the solver must use longer elimination chains.
